overview: Torque Fit is a fitness companion app with AI coaches, calorie tracking, challenges, friends, and ranks on the Internet Computer.
features: AI coaches for diet, gym, and sports that respond to your messages
Calorie camera with barcode scanning and food logging
Challenges with photo proof and auto-tracked 7-day login streak
Friends system with search, requests, and chat
Rank and rewards system with badges and XP
Privacy Policy, Terms, and health disclaimer pages
